G1500.et: probably from (1502) (through the idea of failure)
G1500.def: probably from «1502» (through the idea of failure); idly, i.e. without reason (or effect):--without a cause, (in) vain(-ly).

G1502.def: apparently a primary verb; properly, to be weak, i.e. yield:--give place.

G1503.et: apparently a root word [perhaps akin to (1502) through the idea of faintness as a copy]
G1503.def: apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to «1502» through the idea of faintness as a copy); to resemble:--be like.

G1504.def: from «1503»; a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or (figuratively) representation, resemblance:--image.

G1506.def: from heile (the sun's ray) and «2919»; judged by sunlight, i.e. tested as genuine (figuratively):--pure, sincere.

G1507.et: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb heilo (of the same meaning)
G1507.def: a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb heilo (of the same meaning); to coil or wrap:--roll together. See also «1667».

G1508.def: from «1487» and «3361»; if not:--but, except (that), if not, more than, save (only) that, saving, till.

G1509.def: from «1508» and the neuter of «5100»; if not somewhat:--except.

G1510.et: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb
G1510.def: the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic):--am, have been, × it is I, was. See also «1488», «1498», «1511», «1527», «2258», «2071», «2070», «2075», «2076», «2771», «2468», «5600».

G1511.def: present infinitive from «1510»; to exist:--am, was. come, is, × lust after, × please well, there is, to be, was.

G1512.def: from «1487» and «4007»; if perhaps:--if so be (that), seeing, though.

G1513.def: from «1487» and «4458»; if somehow:--if by any means.

G1514.def: from «1515»; to be (act) peaceful:--be at (have, live in) peace, live peaceably.

G1515.et: probably from a primary verb eiro (to join)
G1515.def: probably from a primary verb eiro (to join); peace (literally or figuratively); by implication, prosperity:--one, peace, quietness, rest, + set at one again.

G1517.def: from «1518»; to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to harmonize:--make peace.

G1519.def: a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.); also in adverbial phrases:--(abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at, (back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore, + forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), ...ward, (where-)fore, with. Often used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs (etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively).

G1520.def: (including the neuter (etc.) hen); a primary numeral; one:--a(-n, -ny, certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See also «1527», «3367», «3391», «3762».

G1521.def: from «1519» and «71»; to introduce (literally or figuratively):--bring in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.

G1523.def: from «1519» and «1209»; to take into one's favor:--receive.

G1524.def: from «1519» and eimi (to go); to enter:--enter (go) into.

G1525.def: from «1519» and «2064»; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise, come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).

G1526.et: third person plural present indicative of (1510)
G1526.def: 3d person plural present indicative of «1510»; they are:--agree, are, be, dure, × is, were.

G1527.def: from «1520» repeated with «2596» inserted; severally:--one by one.

G1528.def: from «1519» and «2564»; to invite in:--call in.

G1529.def: from «1519» and «3598»; an entrance (literally or figuratively):--coming, enter(-ing) in (to).

G1530.def: from «1519» and pedao (to leap); to rush in:--run (spring) in.

G1531.def: from «1519» and «4198»; to enter (literally or figuratively):--come (enter) in, go into.

G1532.def: from «1519» and «5143»; to hasten inward:--run in.

G1533.def: from «1519» and «5342»; to carry inward (literally or figuratively):--bring (in), lead into.

G1534.def: of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then. See also «1899».

G1535.def: from «1487» and «5037»; if too:--if, or, whether.

G1536.def: from «1487» and «5100»; if any:--he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

G1537.et: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause
G1537.def: a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or figurative; direct or remote):--after, among, × are, at, betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above), for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, × heavenly, × hereby, + very highly, in, ...ly, (because, by reason) of, off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, × thenceforth, through, × unto, × vehemently, with(-out). Often used in composition, with the same general import; often of completion.

G1538.et: as if a superlative of hekas (afar)
G1538.def: as if a superlative of hekas (afar); each or every:--any, both, each (one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.

G1539.def: as if from «1538» and «5119»; at every time:--always.

G1542.et: from (1540) and a presumed derivative of (4111)
G1542.def: from «1540» and a presumed derivative of «4111»; a hundred times:--hundredfold.

G1543.def: from «1540» and «757»; the captain of one hundred men:--centurion.

G1544.def: from «1537» and «906»; to eject (literally or figuratively):--bring forth, cast (forth, out), drive (out), expel, leave, pluck (pull, take, thrust) out, put forth (out), send away (forth, out).

G1545.et: from a compound of (1537) and the base of (939) (meaning to go out)
G1545.def: from a compound of «1537» and the base of «939» (meaning to go out); an exit (literally or figuratively):--end, way to escape.

G1546.def: from «1544»; ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the cargo:--+ lighten the ship.

G1547.def: from «1537» and a form of «1061» (compare «1548»); to marry off a daughter:--give in marriage.

G1548.def: from «1537» and «1061»; the same as 1547:--give in marriage.

G1549.et: neuter of a derivative of a compound of (1537) and (1096)
G1549.def: neuter of a derivative of a compound of «1537» and «1096»; a descendant, i.e. (specially) grandchild:--nephew.

G1550.def: from «1537» and «1159»; to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively) exhaust:--spend.

G1551.def: from «1537» and «1209»; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication) to await:--expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

G1553.def: from a compound of «1537» and «1218»; to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively) vacate or quit:--be absent.

G1554.def: from «1537» and «1325»; to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease:--let forth (out).

G1555.et: from (1537) and a compound of (1223) and (2233)
G1555.def: from «1537» and a compound of «1223» and «2233»; to narrate through wholly:--declare.

G1558.def: from «1537» and «1349»; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:--a (re-)venger.

G1559.def: from «1537» and «1377»; to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute implacably:--persecute.

G1560.def: from «1537» and a derivative of «1325»; given out or over, i.e. surrendered:--delivered.

G1562.def: from «1537» and the base of «1416»; to cause to sink out of, i.e. (specially as of clothing) to divest:--strip, take off from, unclothe.

G1563.def: of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:--there, thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).

G1564.def: from «1563»; thence:--from that place, (from) thence, there.

G1565.def: from «1563»; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the article prefixed:--he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same, very), × their, × them, they, this, those. See also «3778».

G1567.def: from «1537» and «2212»; to search out, i.e. (figuratively)investigate, crave, demand, (by Hebraism) worship:--en- (re-)quire, seek after (carefully, diligently).

G1568.def: from «1569»; to astonish utterly:--affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

G1570.def: from «1537» and a derivative of «5087»; put out, i.e. exposed to perish:--cast out.

G1573.def: from «1537» and «2556»; to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail (in heart):--faint, be weary.

G1574.def: from «1537» and the base of «2759»; to transfix:--pierce.

G1576.def: from «1537» and «2808»; to shut out (literally or figuratively):--exclude.

G1577.et: from a compound of (1537) and a derivative of (2564)
G1577.def: from a compound of «1537» and a derivative of «2564»; a calling out, i.e. (concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation (Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or saints in heaven or both):--assembly, church.

G1578.def: from «1537» and «2827»; to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety):--avoid, eschew, go out of the way.

G1579.def: from «1537» and «2860»; to escape by swimming:--swim out.

G1580.def: from «1537» and «2865»; to bear forth (to burial):--carry out.

G1581.def: from «1537» and «2875»; to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate:--cut down (off, out), hew down, hinder.

G1582.def: middle voice from «1537» and «2910»; to hang upon the lips of a speaker, i.e. listen closely:--be very attentive.

G1584.def: from «1537» and «2989»; to be resplendent:--shine forth.

G1585.def: middle voice from «1537» and «2990»; to be utterly oblivious of:--forget.

G1586.et: middle voice from (1537) and (3004) (in its primary sense)
G1586.def: middle voice from «1537» and «3004» (in its primary sense); to select:--make choice, choose (out), chosen.

G1587.def: from «1537» and «3007»; to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die):--fail.

G1588.def: from «1586»; select; by implication, favorite:--chosen, elect.

G1590.def: from «1537» and «3089»; to relax (literally or figuratively):--faint.

G1591.def: from «1537» and the base of «3145»; to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to wipe dry:--wipe.

G1592.def: from «1537» and «3456»; to sneer outright at:--deride.

G1593.def: from «1537» and «3506»; (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly withdraw:--convey self away.

G1594.def: from «1537» and «3525»; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of stupor:--awake.

G1595.def: neuter of a derivative from «1635»; voluntariness:--willingly.

G1596.def: adverb from the same as «1595»; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.

G1597.def: from «1537» and «3819»; long ago, for a long while:--of a long time, of old.
